name: Finding the Center (Ki)
body:
You bend the flows of your magical powers to strike enemies at the heart of their ki.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As a swift action, you can spend 1 point from your ki pool to increase the save DC by +1 for one spell, spell-like ability, or spell-completion or spell-trigger item you use before the end of your turn. As a move action, you can spend 2 points from your ki pool to increase the save DC of such an effect by +2. These bonuses stack with other modifiers to save DCs but do not stack with themselves or each other.
